title: CLI Response Projection Provenance Closure
root_cause: Phase 2201 enriched method response products with method-owned DTO contract judgments, but the response scanner discarded the resulting AST projection judgments and the CLI-facing SourceAsts aggregate retained only projected definitions and ASTs.
changes: The response scanner derives ResponseDefinition and ResponseAst values from the same retained projection judgments.
SourceAsts now preserves responseProjectionJudgments from the response bundle.
LaravelSourceAstPipelineInterface, LaravelSourceAstScannerInterface, and both wired implementations increased from contract version 3 to 4.
Added structural tests for projection retention and CLI-facing source-AST forwarding.

validation.typescript_syntax_transpilation: 7/7 changed TypeScript files passed transpileModule syntax diagnostics

remaining_gaps: The existing responseScanner remains under the legacy subscanners directory; its acquisition responsibilities still need an interface-first migration before the directory can be retired.
DTO contract judgments are preserved as provenance but are not yet an input to the canonical response output-type judgment; any such semantic contribution requires an upstream contract-level proof.
Full TypeScript typecheck, Vitest, and package build have not been executed.
